positions.commentary: Facebook Marketplace has become a core component of Meta's business.

The speaker mentions Airbnb in the context of a laundry machine purchase, but offers no specific view on the company.

thesis: This episode argues that the future of commerce is defined by platforms that successfully open up to third-party sellers to dramatically increase supply, citing Amazon as the prime example. It also highlights the strategic importance of Facebook Marketplace as a core business component for Meta and notes DoorDash's use of custom algorithms to predict user orders.

claims.claim: Facebook Marketplace has become a core component of Meta's business.
claims.quote: You know, another trend we've seen is that a bunch of non-marketplace companies are entering the marketplace category, perhaps most notably a few social companies like Facebook. Facebook marketplace has become a core component of that business.

claims.claim: Amazon is cited as one of the best examples of a platform that opened up to third-party sellers, dramatically increasing supply.
claims.quote: And I mean, some of you are too young to remember this, but like, Amazon is ultimately one of the best examples of this, right? Where when they opened up to third-party sellers, that dramatically increased the supply of what you can buy on Amazon, right?

claims.claim: DoorDash has a custom algorithm that predicts what users are likely to order based on past behavior and location.
claims.quote: This is kind of similar to what Doordash does now as well and has been doing for a few years. They've published a ton of blog post about this, but they've had a very custom algorithm where they kind of predict based on what you've looked at and what people around you have ordered all of these factors.

claims.claim: The speaker mentions Airbnb in the context of a laundry machine purchase, but offers no specific view on the company.
claims.quote: I want to know how many listeners are going to end up buying this laundry machine from this podcast. I got a, I need a referral code. Yeah, I think on top of also all the information and users that you have on your users.
